args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1). Rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident describing the rollback.

Summary of what I did:
- **Diagnosed**: `get_service_status` showed checkout-api on v2.3.1 was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) in all regions. `list_deployments` confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
- **Rolled back**: `rollback` to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — status `rolled_out`.
- **Opened incident**: SEV2 for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0.
